otaUpdate.title: Ultra-Smooth 60 FPS & Instant Cold Launch ⚡
highlights: Silky UI-Thread Motion: Bottom navigation capsules, numeric keypad slide, Insights donut sweep, period stretch dots, and savings progress bar now run directly on the UI thread with Reanimated and RNGH for stutter-free 60 FPS interactions
Consistent Native Press Feel: Upgraded buttons and pressables across 22 screens and modals to instant native touch response
Accelerated Cold Launch: Parallelized session verification, network connectivity checks, and Gullak hydration for faster startup
Lighter & Faster App: Streamlined icon loading and lazy navigation initialization reduce memory overhead and launch latency

Pure Mode Polish: The Pure Mode bottom bar features the same height, padding, and animations as the Budget bar with a compact 3-tab pill and 48dp FAB button, and the Home ring shows a single spent ring just like Budget Mode
Instant First Switch: New accounts and accounts with zero expenses that turn on Budget Mode start right away with their set amount and active daily budget on Home, no waiting for tomorrow
Factory Reset on Account Delete: Deleting an account completely unlinks on-device encrypted AutoLog database, purges SecureStore keys, and clears local storage for a fresh start
Profile Screen Polish: Streamlined Smart Budget & Gullak card styling on Profile screen with 44x44 icon container, crisp 16px bold title, and zero font squashing across all screen display scales

Income Categories: Income now has its own categories (Salary, Freelance, Interest, Gift, Other Income). Pick one when you add income, and manage both kinds from one screen with an Expense | Income toggle
Review Fix: Auto-logged transactions can no longer loop back to review. A category is required, so saving finishes the review for good

Ambient Nav Scrim & Soft Dissolve: Full-width gradient ambient scrim behind the floating nav bar and a 44dp ease-in scroll dissolve for recent transactions, eliminating harsh cutoffs when cards scroll under the navigation bar
Insights Cash Flow: Unified single-capsule stacked bar with warm organic amber gradient bridge and bottom-to-top rising spring animation

Blink-Free Monthly & Weekly Sync: Eliminated 1-frame layout blink in Monthly cash flow with native driver, and unified responsive bouncy rising animations across all week/month navigations and tab re-visits
Balanced Bottom Navigation: Symmetrical active capsule padding between Home and Insights without shifting resting icon coordinates
Responsive Bottom Nav: Concentric 48dp capsule geometry, larger bold typography, and responsive edge padding tailored for all screen sizes
Payback Review: Choose the person then confirm settlement, with automatic hold for credits matching outstanding split balances
Smoother Motion: Glitch-free splash that always opens from the centre, blink-free Home rings, and swipe down to close the Home card breakdown
Engine Optimization: Root re-render elimination on tab/route changes, debounced search, batch I/O, and stabilized callbacks for 60/120 FPS performance
Welcome Back Savings: Smart gap-filler prompts to save unspent daily budget to Gullak after zero-activity days with 1-tap confirmation
Offline Reliability: Safe category fallback prevents dropped offline expenses, token refresh storm eliminated, and smooth chart decimals
Liquid Pills & Motion Polish: Distance-aware two-edge pill physics with zero drift, no jitter, instant settle, and iOS landing tick
Squish Toggle: Tactile squish-and-slide on/off switches across all settings and forms with native UI-thread animation
Rolling Numbers: Silky 460ms soft-landing ease and left-to-right digit ripple across all financial balances
Payback Review: Settling a friend's payback in AutoLog closes review immediately with accurate category restoration
Unified Calculation Layer: Standardized daily budget rate based on true calendar days per month and single-pass ledger accounting across all screens
AutoLog Review: Clean vertical spacing, emoji-free typography, default unchecked merchant preference, and instant self-transfer for incoming credits
Home Card Breakdown: Preserves active budget allowance & reconciles unspent income in All-time sheet with real piggy bank bounds
History Screen: 4-day progressive pagination with 'See More' button for buttery-smooth, jitter-free category transitions
Home Screen: 60/120 FPS pill switching with decoupled odometer roll choreography & zero-jitter transition
Ledger: Streamlined minimalist rows with 1-tap settlement sheet, eliminating pill fatigue while keeping Settle All as the primary action
Split an expense with friends and see exactly what each person owes you
When a friend pays you back, it is no longer counted as income
Refunds go back to their expense — choose to split across everyone, just for you, or for a specific friend
New Ledger button on Home: see who owes you, what was paid back and what is settled
Tap the Home card for a full breakdown of budget, money in and Gullak
Notifications and review now ask "Is this their payment?" for money from someone who owes you
Mode switching takes effect next day at midnight, protecting today's budget and savings rollover
Concise AutoLog Review: Compact split-row receipt, horizontal category scroll with edge gradients, and 1-tap self-transfer rule automation
Spending Guard: Add money directly inside the sheet when balance is ₹0 without losing your typed expense
Instant Budget Update: When you have spent ₹0, budget updates apply immediately today without waiting for tomorrow
Expense Form: Category selection keeps the numeric keypad open for uninterrupted typing
Apple-Grade Motion: Silky-smooth pill toggle and category filter animations with auto-centering and zero distortion
Network Resilience: Fixed false 'You are offline' banner on slow networks with per-page timeouts, automatic retries, and strict connectivity validation
Yearly Insights: Fixed annual inflow calculation to strictly attribute outside deposits and prevent income transfers from double-counting
Savings Hub: Seamless Pure Mode transition scheduling from Savings tab with same-day cancellation and safe streak protection
Backdated Spending: Contextual transparency chip and smart shortfall guarding for past dates without active budget
Scheduled Catchup: Matured budget plans and cadence switches activate reliably after multi-day app breaks
Multi-Cadence Insights: Weekly and Monthly savings accurately reflect period rollovers, with a dedicated Month Budget Share tracker for monthly planners on the weekly tab
Auto-Log Review & Split: Instant review banner clearance on Home when saving a split expense without requiring duplicate reviews
Split Expense Form: Smart keyboard runway and auto-scroll positioning keep person names and amounts fully visible while typing
Gullak Reconciliation: Editing or deleting income prompts confirmation and auto-adjusts funded Gullak savings, keeping real balance accurate
Split Equally: Precision paise distribution prevents form submission errors on odd split amounts
Instant Cold Launch: Faster app startup with an optimized 500ms entrance
Delightful Ticker Motion: Seamless digit roll animation across all filter switches including Mondays, with zero-lag background waterfall calculations
Form Consistency: 'Transfer between accounts' now uses a sleek capsule pill with custom animated toggle matching the rest of the form
Sliding Income Toggle: 'What is this money?' upgraded to an executive sliding toggle with balanced vertical spacing and glitch-free alignment
Instant Response: Re-render optimizations, memoized components, and instant ledger early-exit checks deliver fluid 60fps across Home, Savings, and Insights
